answers.core:
Even if I knew how to do that (assuming it's even possible to alter something like that in an add-on), I would prefer not to bundle my add-on with something that alters such low-level functionality.

And if it's not in the project's interest to implement a way to get around the safety guard, I'd appreciate it if the restriction was at least mentioned within the documentation.
answers.workaround:
It can be worked around by simply manually typing in the code. It looks a bit more cluttered though, and I'd prefer it if I could simply reuse the number incrementing logic as a simple **ShaderInclude** when needed.

```glsl
#if PAPER_USE_CUSTOM_TEXTURE_SLOTS
	#define SLOT_CUR 0
	
	#if PAPER_FEATURE_METALNESS
		#define SLOT_METAL CUSTOM_TEX(SLOT_CUR)
		#undef SLOT_CUR
		#define SLOT_CUR 1
	#endif
	#if PAPER_FEATURE_ROUGHNESS
		#define SLOT_ROUGH CUSTOM_TEX(SLOT_CUR)
		#if SLOT_CUR == 0
			#undef SLOT_CUR
			#define SLOT_CUR 1
		#else
			#undef SLOT_CUR
			#define SLOT_CUR 2
		#endif
	#endif
	#if PAPER_FEATURE_SPECULAR
		#define SLOT_SPEC CUSTOM_TEX(SLOT_CUR)
		#if SLOT_CUR == 0
			#undef SLOT_CUR
			#define SLOT_CUR 1
		#elif SLOT_CUR == 1
			#undef SLOT_CUR
			#define SLOT_CUR 2
		#else
			#undef SLOT_CUR
			#define SLOT_CUR 3
		#endif
	#endif
	#if PAPER_FEATURE_AO
		#define SLOT_AO CUSTOM_TEX(SLOT_CUR)
		#if SLOT_CUR == 0
			#undef SLOT_CUR
			#define SLOT_CUR 1
		#elif SLOT_CUR == 1
			#undef SLOT_CUR
			#define SLOT_CUR 2
		#elif SLOT_CUR == 2
			#undef SLOT_CUR
			#define SLOT_CUR 3
		#else
			#undef SLOT_CUR
			#define SLOT_CUR 4
		#endif
	#endif
	#if PAPER_FEATURE_EMISSIVE
		#define SLOT_EMISSIVE CUSTOM_TEX(SLOT_CUR)
		#if SLOT_CUR == 0
			#undef SLOT_CUR
			#define SLOT_CUR 1
		#elif SLOT_CUR == 1
			#undef SLOT_CUR
			#define SLOT_CUR 2
		#elif SLOT_CUR == 2
			#undef SLOT_CUR
			#define SLOT_CUR 3
		#elif SLOT_CUR == 3
			#undef SLOT_CUR
			#define SLOT_CUR 4
		#else
			#undef SLOT_CUR
			#define SLOT_CUR 5
		#endif
	#endif
	#if PAPER_FEATURE_NORMAL
		#define SLOT_NORMAL CUSTOM_TEX(SLOT_CUR)
	#endif
#endif
```
